card.name: Words just before the word 'to'
card.fires_on: A word that needs 'to' right after it, such as prone, susceptible, sensitive, used, subject, led, response or reactions. The next word is expected to be 'to'.

modes.label: Adjectives taking 'to'
modes.description: Adjective or participle expecting 'to' to introduce what someone is vulnerable or used to.
modes.example: it is more<< prone>> to injuries than other bones in the foot

modes.label: Nouns and verbs taking 'to'
modes.description: Noun or verb followed by 'to' that links to a target or result.
modes.example: Research has already<< led>> to advances, such as photodynamic therapy

modes.label: Phrasal 'get around'
modes.description: A casual phrase where 'to' follows 'around' to mean getting to do something.
modes.example: you’ve been meaning to get<< around>> to building that backyard composting bin…

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting 'to' (and its equivalents in other languages) as the next word.
card.plain: It marks words that are almost always followed by 'to', like 'prone to' or 'sensitive to'.
